blocks.text: Amides mein functional group –CO–NH₂ hota hai. Yeh carboxylic acids se banaye jate hain, isi liye amides ko ab bhi kabhi kabhi “acid amides” kaha jata hai.
Amides in tareeqon se banaye ja sakte hain:
1. Acyl chlorides ka ammonia se reaction

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-Cl + NH3 se CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + HCl. Neeche: benzoyl chloride (ring-C(=O)-Cl) + NH3 se benzamide (ring-C(=O)-NH2) + HCl.
blocks.caption: Acyl chlorides aur ammonia se amides (kitab ke page 127 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: 2. Acyl chlorides ka primary amines se reaction

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-Cl (ethanoyl chloride) + CH3-CH2-NH2 se CH3-C(=O)-NH-CH2-CH3 (N-ethyl ethanamide) + HCl. Neeche: CH3-C(=O)-Cl + phenyl amine se CH3-C(=O)-NH-ring (N-phenyl ethanamide) + HCl.
blocks.caption: Acyl chlorides aur primary amines se amides (kitab ke page 127 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: In dono tareeqon mein sab reactions room temperature par hote hain aur hydrogen chloride (HCl) ke white fumes (safaid dhuan) nikalte hain. Banne wala HCl ammonia ya amine ke aik aur molecule se react kar ke salt bana leta hai.

blocks.alt: R-NH2 + HCl se R-NH3(+) Cl(-). Neeche: NH3 + HCl se NH4(+) Cl(-).
blocks.caption: Amine aur ammonia ka HCl se salt banana (kitab ke page 128 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Is liye reaction poora karne ke liye ammonia ya amine excess (zyada) mein li jati hai.

Methanamide liquid hai; is ke ilawa sab amides solid hain aur in ka melting point sharp (bilkul tay) hota hai. Molecules ke beech strong (mazboot) hydrogen bonding ki wajah se in ke boiling points kaafi oonche hain. N-substituted amides mein jitne zyada alkyl groups lagte hain, hydrogen bonding ki jagahen (N–H) utni kam hoti hain, is liye melting aur boiling points kam ho jate hain.
Amides ki basic properties

Amides aliphatic amines se kam basic hain. Amines ke ulat, amides paani mein neutral solution banate hain. In mein resonance hoti hai: nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl group ke oxygen ki taraf phail (delocalise ho) jata hai. Is se nitrogen par electrons kam milte hain aur basicity kam ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-NH2 jis ke N par lone pair aur do curly arrows hain (C=O ke electrons O par; N ka lone pair C-N bond mein), double-headed resonance arrow, aur R-C(-O-)=NH2+.
blocks.caption: Amide mein resonance (kitab ke page 128 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle structure mein C=O ke electrons oxygen par jate hain aur nitrogen ka lone pair C–N bond mein aa jata hai. Doosre structure mein oxygen negative aur nitrogen positive hai aur C=N double bond hai. Asal amide in dono ke beech hai, is liye nitrogen ka lone pair kam milta hai (amide weak base hai) aur C–N bond aam single bond se chhota hai.
Carbon aur nitrogen ke beech double bond character (double bond jaisi khoobi) aa jane se amide ka C–N bond (132 pm) aam C–N single bond (147 pm) se chhota ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-NH2 ke C-N bond ki taraf arrow, label (132 pm); aur R-CH2-NH2 ke C-N bond ki taraf arrow, label (147 pm).
blocks.caption: Amide aur amine mein C-N bond length (lambai) (kitab ke page 128 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Amides ke reactions

Amides saare acid derivatives mein sab se kam reactive hain, kyunke nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl group ke oxygen par phaila hua hai, jis se carbonyl carbon ka +δ charge (electrophilic power) kam ho jata hai.
Amides ke reactions aam taur par slow (dheere) hote hain aur in ke liye der tak garam karna ya catalyst (acid ya base) chahiye. In mein se kuch yeh hain:
1. Hydrolysis
Jin amides ke nitrogen par koi group na ho (unsubstituted amides), woh acid ke saath carboxylic acid aur ammonium salt dete hain.

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + H2O + HCl se CH3-C(=O)-OH + NH4Cl.
blocks.caption: Ethanamide ki acid hydrolysis (kitab ke page 128 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Base ki madad se (base-catalyzed) hydrolysis mein carboxylic acid ka salt aur ammonia bante hain. Is salt ko dilute hydrochloric acid se treat karne par free (azad) carboxylic acid milta hai.

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + NaOH se CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + NH3. Neeche: CH3-C(=O)-O-Na+ + HCl se CH3-C(=O)-OH + NaCl.
blocks.caption: Ethanamide ki base hydrolysis aur salt se acid (kitab ke page 129 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: 2. Reduction
Dry ethoxyethane (ether) mein lithium tetrahydridoaluminate(III), LiAlH₄, amides ko primary amines mein reduce kar deta hai.

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + 4[H], arrow ke oopar LiAlH4 aur neeche Dry ether, se CH3-CH2-NH2 + H2O. Neeche: benzamide (benzene ring-C(=O)-NH2) + 4[H] (LiAlH4, dry ether) se ring-CH2-NH2 + H2O.
blocks.caption: LiAlH4 se ethanamide aur benzamide ki reduction (kitab ke page 129 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: LiAlH₄ sirf C=O ko CH₂ mein badalta hai: ethanamide se ethanamine aur benzamide se phenylmethanamine (C₆H₅CH₂NH₂) banti hai. Benzene ring waisi hi rehti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne doosri equation mein benzamide aur product dono ki ring mein sirf do double bonds banaye hain, jaise cyclohexadiene ho. Yeh benzene rings hain; is liye drawing mein poori benzene ring hai.

blocks.prompt: Amides amines se kaheen weak (kamzor) bases kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Amide ke nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl oxygen par delocalised hai, is liye proton lene ke liye nahi milta.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Acyl chloride + NH₃ ya primary amine (excess, room temperature) se amides.
Delocalised N lone pair: neutral solution, C–N 132 pm, sab se kam reactive acid derivative.
Hydrolysis (acid: RCOOH + NH₄Cl; base: RCOONa + NH₃); LiAlH₄ se reduction: primary amine.
